claims.claim: Infleqtion reported on September 24 that Sqale demonstrated 30 entangled logical qubits using 80 physical qubits, closing the previously forward 30-logical-qubit roadmap milestone at issuer-demonstration level and reducing—but not eliminating—technical execution uncertainty.

The milestone does not by itself establish independent replication, economic quantum advantage, customer workload superiority, or scalable recurring revenue; those remain the relevant falsifiers for confidence inflation around commercialization.

The September 24 Form 8-K states the milestone disclosure and exhibits were furnished under Item 7.01 rather than filed for Section 18 liability, so Alpha should distinguish the existence of the issuer demonstration from independent validation when weighting risk/confidence.

risks.risk: Issuer-demonstrated logical-qubit progress can be over-extrapolated into commercial/economic advantage before independent replication and customer economics are established.
Successor bottlenecks remain error rates, logical-operation fidelity, scale toward the stated 100-logical-qubit roadmap, workload utility and commercial conversion.

contradictions.contradiction: The prior Beta unknown that achievement of the targeted 30 logical qubits remained open is now partially resolved by a September 24 issuer demonstration; independent verification and customer economics remain open.
contradictions.disposition: milestone achieved at issuer-demonstration level; preserve validation/economics uncertainty rather than treating the old technical milestone as still unmet

unknowns.unknown: Independent replication or third-party validation of the 30-logical-qubit result.
Evidence that customer workloads on Sqale outperform classical or alternative quantum approaches economically.
Conversion of the milestone into durable recurring commercial revenue.

lineage.note: Assist artifact supplements rather than replaces Beta-owned perspectives; it updates the risk/falsifier input for Alpha without setting numeric underwriting.
